relevance_note: Tear-proteomics study of one Italian Blau syndrome family that describes four named carriers individually: 'The p.E383K mutation in the NACHT domain of NOD2 gene is present in patients I1, II1, III1, and III2, confirmed by genetic analysis.'
method_note: Hand extraction from the text (Sections 2.1, 3, 4.1 and 'Clinical Features of NOD2 p.E383K Carriers'); no table holds patient-level data (Tables 1-4 are protein/GO results). In scope: four p.E383K carriers (I1, II1, III1, III2) and three tested-negative relatives (II2 and her children III3, III4); the 4 healthy controls are out of scope and get no rows. cohort_size_as_stated left null: the paper states 'Seven subjects belonging to the same family' plus '4 healthy controls' but never a single total. is_proband left null for everyone: the paper names no proband or index case. Family label: the paper gives no family label (one family; pedigree in Figure 6, not available). Relatives II2, III3, III4 have no variant rows (negative genetic tests); III3/III4 sex not stated ('her children'). Inheritance: II1 inherited from I1 (I1 is a woman and II1 one of her 'two daughters'); III1 and III2 'inherited from patient II1', who is their mother ('passing it on to her children'). Zygosity is never stated. Variant type 'missense' and functional evidence come from the Introduction sentence about p.E383K, which cites earlier studies [2,9]; no assay was done in this paper. II1 'in follow-up since the age of 5' was not recorded as onset (it is the start of follow-up). I1 was 'first examined at the age of 31 in 1984'; diagnosis came 'in 2005' by genetic testing, no age given, so age at diagnosis is not reported. Normal findings: 'fundus examination revealed normal findings' recorded as 'abnormal fundus examination' excluded (whole-examination negative; nothing more specific excluded). III1/III2 'no signs of inflammation' with quiet anterior chambers recorded as excluded ocular inflammation at examination; checklist uveitis left 'not reported' because this describes the current examination, not uveitis history. II2/III3/III4 'did not show signs or symptoms related to the pathology' recorded as one excluded feature row; checklist items left 'not reported' (global negative). Their visual-impairment checklist item is excluded from the named group statement 'Healthy familial subjects ... stable visual acuity at approximately 10/10' (group B, n = 3, inferred from group statement). III1's 'cutaneous and articular symptoms compatible with the onset of the disease' kept as observed feature rows but checklist skin rash and arthritis left 'not reported' (symptoms, not stated as rash or arthritis). Inconsistencies noted: Table 2 caption says 'II2 and III1-2' while the text and table header compare II1 vs III1-2; the Discussion says 'ophthalmological evaluation did not reveal any ongoing inflammation in either of the two patients' without naming them, so it was not used; the Introduction cites [16] (a tear-biomarker review) for the family's treatment, apparently a citation error; the prior description of the patients is cited as [2] ('already characterized in [2]', 'Family tree modified from [2]').
